issues.description: The feeding-sound method is named inconsistently across artifacts. The problem statement refers to getFeedingSound() (e.g. in the per-animal expected return values and in the feedAllAnimals() description), while the provided/solution code and UML use the abstract method name messageOnFeed(). This mismatch (getFeedingSound() in problem text vs. messageOnFeed() in code) can confuse students about which method to implement and which method calls the Farm should make.
issues.suggestedFix: Unify the identifier for the feeding-sound operation across all artifacts. Preferred fix: update the problem statement to replace all occurrences of getFeedingSound() with messageOnFeed() so the text matches the UML and the template/solution code. Alternatively, if getFeedingSound() is desired, rename the abstract method and all call sites in the template/solution to getFeedingSound(). Update examples and tests accordingly.
